subject.title: Discord compaction still fails with provider_error_4xx after #90496 closure on 2026.6.5

question: When Codex native compaction returns a provider 4xx for a Discord-bound oversized session, should OpenClaw rotate/preserve the transcript into a fresh usable lane, surface a provider-auth recovery action, or keep the current fail-closed behavior?
rationale: Current source can show the failure boundary, but the desired recovery policy affects session state, message delivery, and provider-auth behavior for existing users.

options.title: Choose Explicit Recovery Policy
options.body: Keep this issue open for owner review and live proof before implementing provider-4xx rotation or provider-auth guidance.

options.title: Defer To Timeout Work
options.body: Treat this as adjacent to timeout-progress work, accepting that production Codex 403 recovery remains unresolved until another concrete report appears.

recommendation.title: Choose Explicit Recovery Policy
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for owner review and live proof before implementing provider-4xx rotation or provider-auth guidance.

likelyOwner.reason: He has recent Codex app-server control and harness work near the runtime boundary and is the strongest maintainer-routing candidate in the history checked.
